description: This is a shell script for setting up and launching a FastAPI backend server using uvicorn. It manages environment variables, toolchain checks, virtual environment creation, dependency installation, import diagnostics, port binding verification, and finally starts the uvicorn server with specified settings.
external_methods: python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

methods.name: ts
methods.description: Returns current UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs warning messages with timestamp to stderr.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Logs error messages with timestamp to stderr and exits script.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Prints a section header for clarity in logs.

methods.name: print_502_hints
methods.description: Outputs common causes and troubleshooting tips for 502 Bad Gateway errors.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Handles errors during script execution, printing hints for troubleshooting.

calls: python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
